meta.title: Peak Price Pal
meta.description: Adds a small sun or moon beside the composer's context ring to show whether DeepSeek is billing at peak or off-peak rates. Hover or focus for Beijing time, the next switch, the rule, today's status, and the model route, with the peak and off-peak words color-coded. Hidden on third-party providers such as OpenRouter; no settings, storage, or network requests. The 2026 and 2027 Chinese holiday calendars are bundled; later years fall back to the weekday rule.
